answer: Enrollment binds an identity to one sealed tag of dyed fluid, its nectar mixed once from random pigments so its absorption profile cannot be re-blended. The chamber floor is a stepped terrace, and verifiers read it through five depths, a profile no flat printed copy reproduces; the profile sits in a public registry rejecting near-duplicates. Challenges open only in a ten-minute dawn window at epoch start, and a live five-depth read must land inside it. One tag locks 2,000 credits until exit; 1,000 fakes need 1,000 tags and 1,000 rigs, one rig clearing at most 3 reads per window.
